department: School of Electrical, Computer, and Biomedical Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline for the PhD.

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores are required with the application.
gre_general.quote: a statement of research interest, transcripts, official GRE scores, and three reference letters

gre_subject.value: The page does not name a subject test.

supervisor.value: Admission does not depend on a faculty agreement; the student must have an advisor within the first semester.
supervisor.quote: The student must have an advisor on file within the first semester of enrollment

funding.value: The catalog does not say whether admitted PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: A master's is normally required, but outstanding bachelor's applicants can enter directly.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the program normally requires a Master’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or a related field

also.quote: Applicants with exceptional research potential or outstanding academic qualifications may be considered for direct entry into the program after completion of a Bachelor’s degree

notes: The Engineering Science PhD (electrical and computer engineering concentration, run with SIU Edwardsville) is a second route into engineering, not a separate ECE record: https://gradcatalog.siu.edu/programs/engr/ . English rules follow the Graduate School.
